uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-8249-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
6972-8249-8329--225.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.
6972-8249-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

206-3755-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

645-804-1267-4247.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-804-1267-4247.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor
Repeat each turn.

884-1594-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-1594-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2350-2781-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

955-1368-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
955-1368-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2438-4871-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
2438-4871-5220-5946.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

719-5310-6798-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-5310-6798-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2173-4771-5220-5931.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1456-1987-4002-4423.easyPrerequisites:
You control three additional Islands.
You control three or more lands that share a name.
1456-1987-4002-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping them, adding {3}{U}
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6283-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4659-6283-6823.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Aunt May indestructible.
3490-4659-6283-6823.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

4205-4613-4968.description:
Activate Bloodthirsty Aerialist by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Bloodthirsty Aerialist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4681-4894-5686-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

372-1938-2781.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1938-2781.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian exiled by Glorious Protector
372-1938-2781.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glorious Protector and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Felidar Guardian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Glorious Protector to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Glorious Protector and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Glorious Protector and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

56-1417-5256-6112.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-5256-6112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below and Fumulus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-1417-5256-6112.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

3259-3263-5223-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
3259-3263-5223-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-5223-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

974-2178-2532.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Jaxis.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2178-2532.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put the newest Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers twice, and Jaxis triggers once.
Resolve the first Smaug trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the second Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Jaxis trigger, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1109-1123-1636-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Flayer of the Hatebound does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1109-1123-1636-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound, adding {C}{C}.
Flayer of the Hatebound dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Flayer of the Hatebound enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Flayer of the Hatebound trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Flayer of the Hatebound.
Repeat.

730-880-2757.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1734-4681-5256.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

222-2438-3719.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with base power eight or greater.
You control at least one Saproling.
222-2438-3719.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer, putting two +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice the nontoken creature with base power eight or greater and create at least eight Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and the nontoken creature with base power eight or greater to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
If the nontoken creature has base power nine or greater, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

323-401-2530-3944.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
323-401-2530-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

147-2034-3495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-3495.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2034-3495.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

1558-3854-4840.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Debtors' Knell triggers, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1061-1953-2969.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U}{U} on your first turn, with {2}{U}{U} available on each extra turn
1061-1953-2969.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
1061-1953-2969.description:
Cast Zndrsplt's Judgment by paying {5}{U}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Timestream Navigator token.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it and putting it onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 2.
